title: Unit 408 — three further bedroom directions (D, E, F)
overview: Three new, fully sourced directions for Isah and Ivan, distinct from the six rejected A/B/C schemes: D low timber with paper light and terracotta; E ivory curves with caramel and thin black; F dark timber and leather-look with green velvet-tone textiles and brass. Every visible piece is a real catalogue product; technical essentials stay common by agreement.
requirements: MANDATORY: finished 50 mm mattress, 72 × 78 inches (1828.8 × 1981.2 mm), on continuous flat support with no exposed slats or gaps. No thick mattress, topper or box spring.
All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, bedside lamps, fixtures, mirrors, rugs, textiles, plants and decor. Matching bedside pairs within each design.
Closed practical bedside storage, armrests on every chair, compact console with sourced decor. No extra generic styling objects.
75-inch wall TV baseline; 65-inch minimum, 85-inch optional pending price and clearance checks. 65-inch reference saves ₱12,000 in merchandise before contingency.
Split AC at the window-side corner of the TV wall, with airflow directed away from sleepers. Installer must verify location and capacity.
Mirror on the wall return between the two perpendicular doors. Preserve native irregular geometry, both doors, closet and warm narrow-block parquet.
Common technical essentials are owner-approved. Existing Davies Beige blackout/voile treatment and concealed old window AC remain a fixed room requirement.
procurement_gates: No scheme is purchase-ready until the bed supplier accepts the exact 50 mm mattress and a continuous flat deck. Figaro lists a steel deck (continuity unverified); Fieche and Dylan publish no support type. King outer sizes are unpublished for Figaro and Dylan.

Prices are frozen pass-3 catalogue references (snapshot 20 Oct 2026, 23:14–23:17 Manila) with each line's own price date; beds and soft goods were read from supplier JSON on 20 Oct 2026. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.
Colour and size gates: Fieche variant "Grey" vs sand photo; MX3 console width; Agatha chair and SALTSJÖBADEN swivel footprints; E cushion-cover size; lamp socket types.
TV mount is the True Vision TV73-69F (in stock per manufacturer API); installer to confirm substrate, anchors and Samsung fixings.
Curtain ₱42,420 is the carried 16 October quote reference: ₱36,720 master treatment plus ₱3,800 valance and ₱1,900 sticks allocations. Remeasurement quote required.
Trade/freight/mattress/deck reserves total ₱35,000–84,000 as estimator allowances, not supplier quotations. 10 % contingency added, totals rounded up to the next ₱1,000.
Boards, measured plans and scaled product elevations are the acceptance basis. No AI room renders are included; generation/jobs.json holds optional render jobs with frozen references.
